title: Tenant-private prompt source record
purpose: Represent a local sentence-to-pipeline run without storing raw private prompt text.
privacy_rule: Store prompt hash and task parse by default; raw prompt remains tenant-private.

title: Generated blueprint primitive row
purpose: Store model-route, prompt-prefix cache, pricing, eval, deployment, and fact-dependency records as canonical normalized objects.
privacy_rule: Body may include route metadata and dependencies; do not include raw evidence unless tenant-private storage is selected.

title: Blueprint route entity row
purpose: Make route names, task types, risk tiers, modalities, review queues, and verified publishers searchable as graph nodes.
privacy_rule: Entities should be generic or synthetic in public seed data.

title: Deterministic blueprint record dedupe cluster
purpose: Group equivalent generated output records by object type and content hash before promotion or indexing.
privacy_rule: Dedupe hashes should not reveal raw prompt text.

title: Blueprint output review ticket
purpose: Route high-risk, regulated, public-safety, live-pricing-required, or volatile-fact records for review before publication or deployment.
privacy_rule: Review ticket reason should reference task class and risk tier, not private prompt content.

title: Blueprint output index record
purpose: Emit searchable keyword, facet, graph, freshness, quality, and cost records from generated local blueprint records.
privacy_rule: Search text should use normalized metadata and public-safe labels.
